name: United Arab Emirates
summary: The UAE Cybersecurity Council, set up in 2020, leads national cyber policy, while aeCERT handles incident response under the telecoms regulator TDRA. Personal data is governed by Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021; financial free zones such as DIFC and ADGM run their own data protection regimes.
